title: Microsoft Teams Rooms on Android: modernised Gallery view prioritises video on stage
summary: The briefing accurately reports the rollout, default layout and general device-settings route. It needs correction because its open questions present the Pro licence requirement for remote configuration as unresolved, although both its licensing section and Microsoft's comparison table settle that requirement.

claims.where: title; summary; What's changing
claims.claim: The modernised Gallery view changes Teams Rooms on Android to prioritise video participants on stage.
claims.quote: The updated Gallery view in Teams Rooms on Android prioritizes video on the meeting stage

claims.where: What's changing
claims.claim: Participant tiles use consistent aspect ratios.
claims.quote: arranges participants in consistent aspect ratios

claims.where: What's changing
claims.claim: Participant tiles move less on stage.
claims.quote: minimizes movement of participant tiles on stage

claims.where: What's changing
claims.claim: MC1446797 names 16:9, 4:3 and 1:1 aspect ratios.
claims.quote: Participant tiles will be displayed using more consistent aspect ratios, including 16:9, 4:3, and 1:1 layouts.

claims.where: What's changing
claims.claim: The change aligns the experience more closely with Teams Rooms on Windows.
claims.quote: This update aligns the experience more closely with Teams Rooms on Windows

claims.claim: Video prioritisation is on by default and changes the stage layout without an administrator enabling it.
claims.quote: After this rollout: - Gallery view will prioritize video participants on the meeting stage by default

claims.claim: Audio participants are deprioritised when video prioritisation is enabled to help display more video participants.

claims.quote: Display audio and video participants equally instead of prioritizing video participants.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Change & support
claims.claim: Video prioritisation makes the room display show fewer audio-only attendees.
claims.quote: Searched: Teams Rooms Android modernized Gallery default video prioritization local device settings setting name. Read rooms-release-note and MC1446797: they say audio participants are deprioritised and more video participants fit, not that fewer audio attendees are displayed.
claims.fix: Replace 'so in meetings with many audio-only attendees the room display shows fewer of them' with 'helping display more video participants on screen', as MC1446797 states.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Change & support; Governance guidance: At rollout
claims.claim: Apply Now restarts the device as soon as possible.
claims.quote: Apply Now - Queues a job to apply the setting and restarts the device as soon as possible to apply the setting changes.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Change & support; Governance guidance: At rollout
claims.claim: Schedule Later applies changes during the nightly maintenance window to avoid disrupting meetings.
claims.quote: Schedule Later - Schedules the settings change to be applied during the nightly maintenance window to avoid disrupting scheduled meetings during business hours.
